newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen opening higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen opening higher.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to gain at the open on Wednesday, helped by a lower interest rate environment and hopeful about upcoming economic data and the long-term benefits of new tax-cut proposals.
The Standard & Poor's 500 futures index rose 2.15 points to 949.15. The long bond rose 14/32 to yield 6.36 percent.

"The focus is starting to shift to Friday's employment numbers, but based on how the market is moving, most investors appear to think those numbers will be tame," Sam Stovall, an analyst at S&P industry reports, said.
Markets would also watch June new home sales, due today.
